findings: The helper already synchronizes a live-painted weather widget into the V366 signature before every visible non-forced home refresh.
After the canonical renderer returned, the helper queued the same weather-signature scan again in requestAnimationFrame.
A canonical full render already writes the current weather into both DOM and signature, while a signature hit is already handled by the pre-render sync.
changes: Removed the redundant post-render syncPaintedWeatherSignature call.
The pre-render HOME-8 weather catch-up remains intact and continues preventing full-home rebuilds after targeted weather paints.
Growroom readiness scheduling and Startseite layout fitting remain unchanged.
Added diagnostics and browser QA to ensure one weather signature check per visible refresh instead of two.
